prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: three-panel photographic Mediterranean horizon texture atlas for a game environment, with real transparent sky.
Primary request: Create ONE square high-resolution RGBA atlas containing THREE DIFFERENT very wide, shallow distant landscape strips arranged in three horizontal rows. Each row is a separate complete panoramic landscape, not parts of one vertically divided scene. Request a 3072 by 3072 canvas or highest available resolution. Each landscape strip fills the width, but occupies only the LOWER THIRD of its row. Keep the upper two-thirds of each row completely transparent. Leave a transparent gutter between rows.
Subject: a distant Italian coastal hinterland viewed from a coastal resort. Long gentle foothills covered with dense olive groves, fine maquis scrub, occasional slender cypress groups, rocky pale limestone and small terraced fields. Sparse hamlets of tiny cream masonry buildings and muted terracotta roofs are embedded among the vegetation. Normal building proportions.
Composition/framing: extremely distant, horizontal stitched panorama, level horizon, 80-degree horizontal field of view per row. Each row should feel 400–900 metres away, with no foreground. Many small landscape features across the width, no large focal villa or individual hero tree. Individual buildings must be less than 0.6 percent of the row width, trees similarly small; no large umbrella trees. The land silhouette is a low undulating band, highest hills no more than 10 percent of the full square canvas height. The lower edge of each row is a continuous dark olive scrub base with no holes or isolated floating pieces. The far left and far right 10 percent of each row are low, softly rolling groves at similar elevations, suitable for overlapping neighboring panoramas.
Row 1: left coastal foothills, subtle terraced limestone and a few very small hamlets.
Row 2: inland broad valley, distant hills, dense fine olive groves and tiny scattered farms.
Row 3: right foothills, winding terraces and sparse small settlements.
Style/medium: a real, crisp high-resolution landscape photograph, not a painting, illustration, miniature, diorama, low-poly scene, game render or stylized concept art. Fine authentic foliage texture. Buildings should look distant and understated.
Lighting/mood: soft late-afternoon coastal light, thin cool grey-blue atmospheric haze lowering contrast across the entire landscape; soft shadows, muted olive greens, grey beige stone, modest warm roofs. No orange cast, black shadows or exaggerated saturated foliage.
Constraints: transparent sky and transparent space around every landscape strip, preserve natural treeline silhouettes, no baked sky, clouds, sea, water, horizon ocean, people, foreground objects, text, labels, frames, borders or checkerboard. Three independent strips, full width, separated, absolutely no shared vertical scene.
